name: Fix My Phone!
desc:
📱 Customers keep breaking their phones. You fix them, by hand!

🔧 Unscrew the back, swap the battery, peel off the smashed glass, fit a new screen, squeeze out every bubble
🎨 Give makeovers: spray paint, laser engraving and gems
🤝 Haggle for trade-ins, fix them up and sell them for more
🏪 Grow your shop: more benches, technicians who work for you, a showroom, a makeover studio and a refurb room
🛋️ Decorate with over 100 pieces of furniture
✨ Rare phones walk in. The rarest is 1 in 10,000!
📦 Open Job Lots and keep what you fix as a trophy
🗓️ A new theme every week, with cases you can only get that week

🎁 CODES: RELEASE · NOBUBBLES · FIXIT

👥 +10% cash for every friend in your server (up to 4)
⭐ Roblox Plus: +20% cash
💚 Join the group for +10% cash

👍 Like and favourite for more updates!
